test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When is the Constitution Day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 26th November.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Constitution Day**, also known as **Samvidhan Divas**, is celebrated in India on **26th November** every year.
 
• It marks the day in 1949 when the **Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution**, which came into effect on 26th January 1950.
 
• The day is observed to honor the architects of the Indian Constitution, especially Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the chairman of the Drafting Committee.
 
• Constitution Day was **first celebrated in 2015 to commemorate the 125th birth anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adoption of the Constitution**: The Constitution of India was adopted on 26th November 1949 but came into effect on 26th January 1950, a day now celebrated as Republic Day.
 
• **Constitution of India**: It is the supreme law of India, providing the framework that defines the fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, and duties of government institutions, and outlines the rights and duties of citizens.
 
• **Drafting Committee**: The Constitution was drafted by the Constituent Assembly, and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the Drafting Committee. The drafting process took nearly three years to complete.
 
• **Significance of Constitution Day**: It serves as a reminder of the values enshrined in the Constitution, such as justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity, and reinforces the importance of civic responsibilities among citizens.
